title: Kissed Herbal Chinese Tofu Mapo Tofu
description: A herbal and crumbly Chinese dish featuring a savory sauce and beurre-monte, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and diabetic-friendly. This dish is a variation of the traditional Mapo tofu recipe.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: silken or soft tofu works best

instructions: Cut the tofu into small cubes and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the herbal sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil, if using.
Heat the beurre-monte in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the chopped scallions and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the tofu cubes and stir-fry until they are lightly browned on all sides.
Pour the herbal sauce mixture into the skillet and stir-fry until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Mapo tofu hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
